text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! Placed on the board. We made the 
top five, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's not bad, I guess. Though if I'm 
being honest, I still wanted more—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to cross the finish line in a 
runaway victory and look totally, 
undisputed cool.
choice_data_list: You looked so cool out there!
You looked so cool out there!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well... if you put it like that, maybe I 
can hold my head a little higher.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, alright, alright, I get it. So, let 
me start over—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
We did it, Trainer! Keep expecting great 
things from me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... You don't have to tell me twice. 
Of course that's what I plan to do!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Besides, that race made me realize 
perfectly what I'm currently lacking!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, ain't that right, ain't that right! 
You just sit back and leave everything to 
me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"In our next race, I'll definitely— show 
you just how super cool I can be!!"
